{{dropinitial|T}}HE hi{{ls}}torie of S. Paul, vntil he came to Rome, S. Luke in the Actes of the Apo{{ls}}tles vvrote exactly: and though vvithout any mention of his Epi{{ls}}tles, yet certaine it is, that {{ls}}ome of them he vvrote before he came there, to vvit, the tvvo vnto the Corinthians, and this to the Romanes: & (as it {{ls}}eemeth) before them al, the Epi{{ls}}tle to the Galatians. {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Gal. 2.''}}Vvherein yet becau{{ls}}e he maketh mention of the fouretenth yere after his conuer{{ls}}ion, it appeareth, that he preached {{ls}}o long vvithout any vvriting.
